items.title: A uniform Beta integral estimate with a logarithmic-delta corollary
items.author: Tony Haddad; Dimitris Koukoulopoulos
items.work: On Arratia's coupling and the Dirichlet law for the factors of a random integer
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `lem:beta estimate` at source lines 1460-1469: a uniform two-sided bound for sin(pi alpha) times the Beta-type integral over [u-delta,u+delta], together with the log-form corollary when delta >= 1/log x. The author's proof (source lines 1471-1496) is a full case analysis rather than an appeal to a standard Beta estimate: it starts with a symmetry reduction (line 1471), normalises the total mass to pi and thereby removes the case delta > 1/4 (lines 1472-1475), reduces the remaining claim to a pure power integral after bounding 1-t below (lines 1477-1481), and then splits into delta <= u/2, where t is bounded below by u/2 (lines 1483-1487), and delta >= u/2, where the integral is extended to [0,3delta] and evaluated to produce delta^alpha (lines 1489-1495). The exponent bookkeeping in the second case, including the comparison delta^alpha ~ delta/(u+delta)^{1-alpha}, is the step that the statement hides.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the lemma, retained line for line
